purpose: A reviewed design for running several useful agents at once across projects, and for choosing the right model for each step.

authorization.grantedBy: owner (netbka), delegated to the owner's main session
authorization.text: On 2026-10-12 the owner directed: "take this as starting point and deliver till end. Delivery this work with the AIWorks environment." The starting point is docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md (PR #12), with owner decisions D1, D3, D5 (direction only) and D9 recorded in its section 8. This campaign writes the designs for workstreams #9 (adaptive concurrency) and #10 (model routing), each ending in small implementation slices. Design documents only. Commits are published as PRs only: the supervisor never merges or deploys, and the live runtime, its data directory, the governance checkout and the scheduled tasks are never touched. No run cap or cost ceiling (AW-002); provider limits are waited out. Provider order Claude, then Codex.

constraints: Program netbka/aiworks#14: deliver docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md through supervisor campaigns. Change only the files your task names. Other campaigns change other files at the same time: never edit their files, other agents' branches or worktrees, or campaigns/*.json.

Your assigned worktree is the only place you change files. Never touch D:/Git/aiworks/.local (live runtime, supervisor data directory, governance checkout, other worktrees) or the main checkout, and never start, stop or restart the supervisor, its scheduled tasks or the dashboard.

No production access, deployment, GitHub Actions changes, paid services, Telegram or other provider API calls, or new recurring spend. Never read .env contents, credentials or secret files. Read Engineering Platform only with read-only gh commands; never write the governance checkout or open changes in another repository: EP-side changes are proposed as text.
Follow AGENTS.md: run npm ci once in your worktree, then npm run check after changes. Report exact commands and pass/fail tallies.

Never weaken an assertion, delete or skip a test, or broaden a timeout to make the gate pass. Tests make no model, network or GitHub calls: synthetic executables and disposable git repositories, as tests/supervisor/helpers.mjs does.

Keep AW-001 to AW-007 as written. Do not enable a power whose decision is still open (GitHub-free local admission, Auto Release, Telegram delivery): design it, or build it switched off, and name the decision it waits for.

Label every claim about the running system observed, verified, planned or unknown (AGENTS.md evidence rule); merged is not deployed. Do not comment on GitHub, merge, close issues or change labels: the supervisor publishes your verified commit. Write "Refs #N", never "Closes".
Write for the owner first: plain English, short sentences, the outcome before the mechanism. Link Engineering Platform policies instead of copying them.

This task writes one design document only: no change to src/, tests/, scripts/, schemas/, registry/ or campaigns/. Decide everything that is not owner-reserved; list owner-reserved questions separately, each with a recommended answer.

tasks.title: Design: adaptive worker concurrency across tasks and projects
tasks.outcome: A reviewed design for running independent steps in parallel, fairly across projects, without two agents ever writing the same thing.
tasks.goal: Write docs/design/ADAPTIVE_SCHEDULER.md for #9 (gh issue view 9 --comments), from docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md section 5.2 and the current controller: schedule and dispatch and the one-slot checks in src/supervisor/controller.mjs, campaignLimits in campaign.mjs, executor_waits, leases and fencing in store.mjs, runner containment. Design: several operations per campaign for independent ready DAG nodes with non-overlapping write domains (declared or derived) and isolated worktrees; fairness across campaigns and projects; host resource and provider health signals; fan-out that starts at one and grows only on useful completions, backing off on failures, throttling or pressure; one cooldown per real provider account across campaigns (executor_waits are per campaign today); verification sequencing; crash, takeover, unknown acceptance and cancellation with no duplicate external write; a plain "why is this waiting" reason per step. Keep AW-002 (no default run or cost caps) separate from host safety limits. Reuse the work ownership of #5 scope A instead of a new lock.
acceptance: Every statement about current behaviour cites file:line at the task base and is labelled observed; nothing is claimed as verified on the live host.
The design names every place the one-slot assumption lives in the code (file:line) and what replaces it, and shows that the SQLite store stays the single work authority.
Race, crash, takeover, quota and cancellation cases each have a named synthetic test that would fail if two writers ran on the same write domain or an external write repeated.

The document ends with numbered implementation slices. Each slice is one reviewable PR and names: the outcome, the files it owns, the tests (synthetic, no network), the acceptance, its dependencies, and whether it waits for an owner or Engineering Platform decision.
Owner-reserved questions are listed separately, each with a recommended answer and what it unblocks; no product question the plan already settled (D1, D3, D5, D9) is asked again.
npm run check passes; the PR states it is a design only and nothing is built or deployed.

tasks.title: Design: cost- and quality-aware model choice per task role
tasks.outcome: A reviewed design for picking the provider and model per step by expected cost of an accepted result, with unknown costs kept unknown.
tasks.goal: Write docs/design/MODEL_ROUTING.md for #10 (gh issue view 10 --comments), from docs/PROJECT_WORKSPACE_PLAN.md section 5.3, the merged docs/design/ADAPTIVE_SCHEDULER.md and the current executor code: src/supervisor/adapters/executors.mjs, claude.mjs and agy.mjs, executorChoice and cost accounting in src/supervisor/controller.mjs, executor_waits. Design: deterministic role, risk and complexity indicators per task; eligibility by this host's configured CLIs, role support (roleUnavailableReason), account availability and verifier independence; choice by expected total cost of an accepted outcome, with tier escalation on evidence of poor quality and never on permission denials; a versioned routing receipt per operation; an owner model pin; native usage units, with unknown cost kept unknown; the role catalog read from Engineering Platform registry/agents.json, not copied. Say how to measure a baseline from existing operation records before any saving is claimed.
acceptance: Every statement about current behaviour cites file:line at the task base and is labelled observed; nothing is claimed as verified on the live host.
The routing decision is reproducible from the receipt alone, and the document shows that a verifier is never routed to the same session or a provider the campaign did not authorize.
The baseline method names the existing store fields it reads and what it cannot measure (unknown cost stays unknown).

The document ends with numbered implementation slices. Each slice is one reviewable PR and names: the outcome, the files it owns, the tests (synthetic, no network), the acceptance, its dependencies, and whether it waits for an owner or Engineering Platform decision.
Owner-reserved questions are listed separately, each with a recommended answer and what it unblocks; no product question the plan already settled (D1, D3, D5, D9) is asked again.
npm run check passes; the PR states it is a design only and nothing is built or deployed.
